## Summary
- Add `doc_lineage.blackline` with `build_section_tree`, `align_sections`, and `lineage-edges/v1` NDJSON emission.
- Pair numbered sections by stable section IDs first; fail closed to `manual_review` when header confidence is below threshold.
- Golden synthetic LPA fixtures plus named acceptance and deliberate-break tests.

## Test plan
- [x] `pytest tests/blackline/test_section_id_pairing.py -q -o addopts=`
- [x] Named gate: `tests/blackline/test_section_id_pairing.py::test_pairs_by_section_id`
- [x] **Deliberate-break gate:** semantic-only pairing misaligns section IDs → `test_deliberate_break_semantic_only_pairs_wrong_sections` must FAIL → revert.

## Automated Status Summary
#### Scope
R1 §1.3 requires section-ID alignment before semantic fallback. Verified: `README.md:9-12` promises blackline output but `tests/test_main.py:23-27` only tests template `add()` — no `blackline` module. **Missing behavior:** no section pairing. **Depends on:** M1 parse (B2-002), adopt sentweave (B2-013) for fallback.

#### Tasks
- [ ] Add `src/doc_lineage/blackline.py` with `align_sections(doc_a, doc_b) -> list[SectionPair]`.
- [ ] Add `tests/blackline/test_section_id_pairing.py` with synthetic mutation fixture.
- [ ] Fail closed to `manual_review` when header confidence < threshold (R2 objection mitigation).

#### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Named test: `tests/blackline/test_section_id_pairing.py::test_pairs_by_section_id` passes on golden pair.
- [ ] **Deliberate-break gate:** force semantic-only path to pair wrong sections → test **must FAIL** → revert.

- [ ] _Surfaced by B2-005._

<!-- auto-status-summary:end -->

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **New Features**
  - Added document section lineage generation from ordered text segments.
  - Added section alignment across document versions using section identifiers and confidence checks.
  - Added manual-review status for missing, duplicate, or low-confidence section matches.
  - Added support for header-only sections and non-finite confidence values.
  - Added standardized, sorted NDJSON export for lineage relationships.
  - Added source hashing to generated document section records.

- **Tests**
  - Added coverage for section construction, alignment, confidence handling, duplicate identifiers, lineage export, and manifest validation behavior.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
